$comment: REQ-STARTUP-142: the release-time inputs of the notices generator (tools/notices/notices.mjs). lgplCorrespondingSourcesAddress is the single address, reachable without an account and monitored by the maintainers, by which a recipient requests the corresponding sources of the LGPL-licensed components; the generator writes it into the header of THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt as a literal string. It is owner item O-3 (docs/architecture/first-release-plan.md section 6) and is left empty until the owner gives it: while it is empty, or only a placeholder, notices validation fails and names this key (REQ-STARTUP-143). The value must have an address's shape: an e-mail address whose domain has a dot (a display name before it in angle brackets is fine), or a postal address of more than one part, separated by commas or line breaks (\n), with a number and words in it. A web page, a placeholder word (N/A, none, TBA, TODO, REPLACE_ME and the like), a template domain such as domain.com, and a domain reserved for examples and tests are refused.
